  "decisions": [
    {
      "id": "D1",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Model B: named port leases. Humans always use the numeric port.",
      "rationale": "Phone/Tailscale/bookmarks and firewall rules are port contracts. A localhost proxy does not fix that.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Portless/Hotel name front door",
        "DNS SRV only"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D2",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "v1 = stable leases + dashboard + host firewall sync; observed listeners in the same board. Amended by D13 to all desktop OSes.",
      "rationale": "Engram timed out on Tailscale because the firewall rule was still on 5173 after the app moved to 5193.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "CLI-only",
        "Firewall later"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D3",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Repo folder localberth. CLI is localberth, not the crowded global berth binary.",
      "rationale": "Folder matches the public name. cargo/@whenlabs/berth already own `berth` on PATH.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Nomenclator",
        "Pharos",
        "PortHub clone name"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D4",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Public name LocalBerth; domain localberth.com is the FilePress explainer (what + how-to), not the running app. Pairing with localhost (machine vs slip), not a replacement for localhost URLs.",
      "rationale": "localhost + LocalBerth read as a pair. Domain is available. Avoids berth CLI/search collisions. Site vs daemon must stay distinct.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Berth only",
        "*.localberth hostnames in v1",
        "Host the dashboard at the domain"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D5",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Stack matches Engram: SvelteKit 5 + Tailwind + pnpm + TypeScript ESM + adapter-node + SQLite (better-sqlite3).",
      "rationale": "Same machine, same muscle memory, Node needed for listen table and firewall.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "CLI-only first"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D6",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Live state in ~/.localberth/. Repo data/ is fixtures only.",
      "rationale": "Leases must survive moving or deleting the git checkout.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Repo data/"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D7",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "License Apache-2.0.",
      "rationale": "Match Engram / ForgeTrail.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Private-only"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D8",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Dashboard self-lease localberth → TCP 54321.",
      "rationale": "High, easy to type, not Postgres 5432.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "3999"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D9",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Rename repo folder berth → localberth.",
      "rationale": "Match public name and domain; /berth was only a short sibling path.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Keep /berth"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D10",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "localberth.com is a FilePress site (in-repo site/). Explains what LocalBerth is and how to use it. Hosted static (Cloudflare Pages, root directory site).",
      "rationale": "Same FilePress pattern as getfilepress.com. Domain must not be mistaken for the local dashboard.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Sibling localberth-www repo",
        "Dashboard hosted at the domain",
        "GitHub README only"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D11",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "The app ships as a published unscoped npm package named localberth (bin localberth). It runs locally after install. Name reserved as localberth@0.0.0 on 2026-08-18.",
      "rationale": "Operator install path is npm/pnpm, not cloning this repo. Avoid the crowded berth bin.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "private: true indefinitely",
        "@catalystforge/localberth only",
        "Global berth bin"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D12",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Publish localberth@0.0.0 as a name stake (placeholder bin, files whitelist). Human publishes; agent does not. Omit homepage, repository, and bugs until localberth.com is live and the GitHub repo is public.",
      "rationale": "Reserve the unscoped npm name before the spine exists. Dead or auth-walled links on the public npm page are worse than no links.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Wait until Phase 2",
        "Scoped package only"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D13",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "v1 is cross-platform. CLI, scan, dashboard, and firewall sync on Windows (netsh), macOS (pf), and Linux (ufw or firewalld). Kickoff was Windows; the product is not Windows-only.",
      "rationale": "Same stale-port / firewall miss happens on any OS that filters inbound LAN or Tailscale.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Windows-first, other OS later",
        "Scan-only on non-Windows"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D14",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Root README is the public npm page: product one-liner + install tease. Process, phase, and sibling notes stay in docs/ and .forgetrail/. Amended by D17.",
      "rationale": "0.0.0 README overshared Phase 1 internals on npmjs.com.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Separate README.npm.md",
        "Keep operator status on the package page"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D15",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "2-scaffolding",
      "decision": "localberth serve is a built-in Node dashboard (no Vite required) so a global npm install can open :54321. pnpm dev stays the SvelteKit board for checkout work.",
      "rationale": "Vite is a devDependency; the installed CLI must still show the harbor board.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Move Vite/SvelteKit to dependencies",
        "Dashboard only via pnpm dev"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D16",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "2-scaffolding",
      "decision": "Firewall hardening: skip inbound for loopback binds; Windows/Linux only create or delete rules named LocalBerth <name> <port> (ufw by comment, firewalld rich rules). macOS writes a pf anchor file and loads anchor localberth.",
      "rationale": "A 127.0.0.1 dashboard must not punch a WAN hole. Never delete an operator rule that happens to share a port.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Always open the port on all interfaces",
        "firewalld default-zone add-port"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D17",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Phase 3 README is a public usage page (install, commands, serve, firewall/loopback, Vite helper, checkout). Still no ForgeTrail, siblings, or machine paths. Amends D14 “short tease”.",
      "rationale": "The spine exists; npm and git checkout readers need the real CLI. Process notes stay in CONTEXT_PROMPT.md / docs / .forgetrail/.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Keep the 0.0.1 tease until Phase 6",
        "Separate README.npm.md"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D18",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "claim --or-next: if --port is leased or listening, assign the next free pool port. Default still allows claiming a listening port (name what is there). Pool allocation always skips listening ports.",
      "rationale": "Prefer-5193-else-free is a real start path; attaching a name to an already-running app is the hero path and must not require a free port.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Fail on any listening port",
        "Always auto-fallback with no flag"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D19",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Public explainer metaphor: LocalBerth is local DNS for ports. Names resolve to TCP numbers on this machine. Still not real DNS, not a reverse proxy, and not *.localhost URLs (D1 / D4).",
      "rationale": "DNS is the familiar name→number lookup. The gap people feel is ports, not hostnames.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Registry-only wording",
        "Port name service without the DNS analogy"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D20",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Public copy follows aiBreze (core + landing). Overlay in docs/aibreze-overlay.md. Protected: localhost/slip pairing and Local DNS for ports. Public pages say dashboard, not harbor board.",
      "rationale": "Same house voice as other Catalyst Forge pages. npm README is a brochure; checkout notes stay last.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Copy-only pass with no package",
        "Landing voice on the flag list"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D21",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-18",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "claim defaults to bind 127.0.0.1. --lan binds 0.0.0.0 and syncs inbound firewall. --bind ADDR still works. --lan and --bind together is an error. Ephemeral is no longer a special-case bind default.",
      "rationale": "Opening past loopback should be intentional, especially once agents invoke claim. Phone/LAN access stays one flag. Same issue raised on DictaWhisper.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Keep 0.0.0.0 default",
        "Require --bind 0.0.0.0 with no --lan shorthand"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D23",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "better-sqlite3 ^13 (N-API prebuilds in the npm tarball). Do not stay on 12.x for the published CLI.",
      "rationale": "npm 12 (Node 24) blocks dependency install scripts. better-sqlite3 12 never downloads a .node on npm i -g localberth. Global installs cannot use package.json allowScripts. 13 ships prebuilds/win32-x64.node and has no install script.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Document --allow-scripts=better-sqlite3 as the hero install",
        "Switch the store to node:sqlite or JSON"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D24",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Dashboard Bind column shows the listen address when the port is up. Expand panel keeps Claim vs Listen. localberthListen() returns host+port so Vite pins the claim bind.",
      "rationale": "Vite default host localhost binds [::1] on Windows. The lease is 127.0.0.1. Showing the claim as the bind hid the miss. Port-only helper left host to Vite.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Keep showing claim bind only",
        "Change claim default to ::1"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D25",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "/api/peek returns 403 unless the TCP peer is loopback (127/8 or ::1). Socket address only; no X-Forwarded-For.",
      "rationale": "When serve is bound past loopback, peek would let a LAN client make the dashboard GET local ports. Board listing stays; active HTTP does not.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Disable peek entirely when serve bind is not loopback",
        "Add a dashboard token"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D26",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Published CLI is tsc output (dist/). tsx is a repo/dev runner only. Runtime npm deps are better-sqlite3.",
      "rationale": "tsx pulls esbuild. npm 12 blocks esbuild's postinstall. Compiled JS is the same on every OS; the only native addon is better-sqlite3, which already ships N-API prebuilds per platform.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Keep tsx as a runtime dep and document --allow-scripts=esbuild",
        "Bundle with esbuild at publish time",
        "Node type-stripping (needs Node 22+, engines are >=20)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D27",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Same :54321; loopback peer gets the operator board, non-loopback gets a visitor menu of listening non-loopback leases. Open links use the request Host. /api/board and /api/peek are loopback-only.",
      "rationale": "Phone on Tailscale should see reachable slips, not PIDs and firewall. Default claim is loopback (D21); visitor menu is the --lan set. One port, no reverse proxy.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Second port for the visitor menu",
        "/guest path on a LAN-bound operator board"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D28",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-20",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Visitor menu is tiles (favicon from the app URL + name + port). Whole tile is the Open link. No version. Operator bind column labels :: as 0.0.0.0.",
      "rationale": "Phone menu should look like apps, not a lease table. The phone loads /favicon.ico itself so LocalBerth does not proxy images. Vite --host on Windows is dual-stack ::; the board should say 0.0.0.0.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "claim --logo / --version fields",
        "LocalBerth fetches and serves favicons",
        "Show raw :: in the bind column"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D29",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-20",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Visitor tiles key off the observed listen bind, not the claim. Still require a named lease.",
      "rationale": "Vite --host makes a 127.0.0.1 claim reachable on Tailscale/LAN. The phone menu should follow the socket, not the lease text.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Require claim --lan before a tile appears",
        "Show unclaimed listeners"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D30",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-20",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Visitor tiles show the peeked HTML title and link rel=icon. Long-press copies the open URL. Header IPv4s are labeled Tailscale (100.64/10) or LAN (RFC1918).",
      "rationale": "The phone should see the app's own name and icon, not only the lease. Peek stays on the LocalBerth host (loopback); /api/peek stays loopback-only. Labels tell you which address is the tailnet vs Wi-Fi.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Phone calls /api/peek",
        "Proxy favicons through LocalBerth",
        "Show PID, firewall, and notes on the visitor face"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D31",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-20",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Public how-to lives at localberth.com/docs (FilePress path mount, same docs shell as ollanet). The npm README is short: install, quick start, link to docs.",
      "rationale": "The CLI and dashboard grew past a one-page README. Marketing pages stay thin; flags and Vite/firewall notes belong in /docs.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Keep growing the npm README",
        "Put the full flag list only on /cli"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D32",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-20",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Operator Leases and Observed are tabs. Each pane has its own scroll box; thead stays pinned. CLI HTML matches the Svelte board.",
      "rationale": "Two stacked tables fight the pinned chrome. One scrolling pane keeps header and footer put.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Keep both tables stacked on one page scroll",
        "Side-by-side tables"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D33",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-23",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Operator tables sort by column (click header to flip). Filter chips: listening/quiet, LAN/loopback, conflict, ephemeral, and firewall status. Same on the CLI HTML board.",
      "rationale": "A long lease list is hard to scan by port or firewall state. Chips stay in one row; sort state is client-side so the 8s refresh does not reset it.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Server query-string sort only",
        "A search box instead of status chips"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D34",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-24",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Named leases can start/stop a stored recipe (default pnpm serve) via localberth start|stop and the LocalHelm Ports plugin. Detached process tree; stop does not release the lease. Observed-only rows stay read-only. Recipe is cwd + command on the lease row.",
      "rationale": "Operator 2026-08-24: start/stop fleet dashboards from LocalHelm, owned by LocalBerth. Do not guess npm run dev.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Spawn from LocalHelm core",
        "Always infer cwd from the lease name",
        "Kill observed-only pids"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D35",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-25",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Log tail is the last 40 lines of ~/.localberth/logs/<name>.log (empty = “No log yet — start once.”). Start plan rows include host (bind) so LocalHelm can print PORT/HOST. localberth doctor is read-only: fail on missing cwd or two listeners; warn on kind=always down and pnpm serve plus a family -api in the same folder. Parked+listening waits for park. Exit 1 only on fail.",
      "rationale": "Operator picked cheap-surfaces B1+B2. The Vite 8008 refuse lived in a log nobody opened. Always-down as fail would make doctor useless on a quiet shop.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Fail doctor when any always lease is down",
        "Block start on HTTP /health",
        "Put 40 log lines in the Ports table cell"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D36",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-25",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Park stops and hides a lease and keeps the port. Default ls hides parked; --parked / --all show them. Unpark does not start. Family start/stop expands unparked siblings. recipe --save-guess stores a guess without starting. Helm plugin Start only when not listening; Stop only when listening; parked rows offer Unpark only.",
      "rationale": "Operator 2026-08-25: Start while listening was noise; cheap-surfaces B3–B5.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Always show Start and Stop",
        "Release the port on park",
        "Unpark also starts"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D37",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-27",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Public rename LocalBerth → LocalSlip. npm package and CLI primary name localslip; localberth remains a compatibility alias. Domains localslip.com and localslip.dev are staked. Tagline stays Local DNS for ports. Data dir stays ~/.localberth (and LOCALBERTH_HOME) until an explicit migration to ~/.localslip. Pairing with LocalHelm unchanged: LocalSlip is the slip; LocalHelm is the wheel. Do not fold into LocalHelm.",
      "rationale": "Operator 2026-08-27: berth sounds like birth and is awkward to say. localslip is open on npm and .com/.dev. Two products/dashboards stay.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Fold into LocalHelm",
        "LocalDock (collides with localdock.dev)",
        "LocalMarina",
        "LocalFleet (collides with Helm Fleet tab)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D38",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-27",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Hard cutover LocalBerth → LocalSlip. Primary site localslip.dev (localslip.com and localberth.com redirect there). Self-lease localslip on 54321. Data dir ~/.localslip + localslip.sqlite (one-shot copy from ~/.localberth). Plugin id localslip. GitHub repo rename to localslip. localberth CLI/bin is a one-release alias only.",
      "rationale": "Operator 2026-08-27: localberth goes away; hard cutover is fine because it is only used locally. Prefer .dev as primary to match localhelm.dev.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Keep ~/.localberth forever",
        "Make localslip.com the primary site",
        "Keep the localberth self-lease name"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D39",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-27",
      "phase": "3-stabilization",
      "decision": "Public dictionary gloss is slip (a boat's allotted place at a dock), not berth. Home .dict and README blockquote match. Overlay product words are slip / lease.",
      "rationale": "Operator 2026-08-27: home must say slip. Berth was the old public name; riding it after LocalSlip is leftover metaphor.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Keep a berth gloss under the LocalSlip hero"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D40",
